metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2005 · Million Dollar Baby
metas.description: Frankie, an ill-tempered old coach, reluctantly agrees to train aspiring boxer Maggie. Impressed with her determination and talent, he helps her become the best and the two soon form a close bond.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2001 · Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
metas.description: The people of a small village in Victorian India stake their future on a game of cricket against their ruthless British rulers.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2007 · Chak De! India
metas.description: Kabir Khan, the coach of the Indian Women's National Hockey Team, dreams of making his all-girls team emerge victorious against all odds.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2007 · The King of Kong: A Fistful of Quarters
metas.description: Die-hard gamers compete to break world records on classic arcade games.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2008 · The Wrestler
metas.description: A faded professional wrestler must retire, but finds his quest for a new life outside the ring a dispiriting struggle.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2005 · The World's Fastest Indian
metas.description: The story of New Zealander Burt Munro, who spent years rebuilding a 1920 Indian motorcycle, which helped him set the land speed world record at Utah's Bonneville Salt Flats in 1967.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2009 · The Blind Side
metas.description: The story of Michael Oher, a homeless and traumatized boy who became an All-American football player and first-round NFL draft pick with the help of a caring woman and her family.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2007 · Shelter
metas.description: When his college dreams are sidelined by family obligations, a young man finds comfort in surfing with his best friend's brother.
